div.div: سَمَادٌ A compost, or manure, consisting of سِرْجِين, (S, Mgh, Msb,) or سِرْقِين, (K,) [both meaning dung of beasts, such as horses, camels, sheep and goats, wild oxen, and the like,] with ashes, (S, K,) or with earth or dust: (Mgh, Msb:) or a manure consisting of strong earth. (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
